title: CoLLMLight: Cooperative Large Language Model Agents for Network-Wide Traffic Signal Control

claim.summary: CoLLMLight coordinates traffic signal agents using neighboring lane histories, complexity-adaptive reasoning and simulation-derived fine-tuning.

modules.name: Spatiotemporal cooperative signal selection
modules.scope_reason: Lane occupancy,queue states,road connectivity and prior signal actions determine network traffic control decisions.
evidence_locators: PDF p.3; passage beginning "To capture the temporal pattern"

modules.name: Congestion-conditioned reasoning-depth selection
modules.scope_reason: The number of critical neighboring lanes gates whether local analysis,prediction or full cooperation is performed.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "We first classify the reasoning complexity"

modules.name: Simulation-derived signal-policy fine-tuning
modules.scope_reason: CityFlow counterfactual rollouts and selected reasoning chains supervise the LLM control policy.
evidence_locators: PDF p.4; passage beginning "To further enhance the reasoning capability"
